Celebrate World Pasta Day with 5 irresistible pasta recipes! From creamy White Sauce Pasta to smoky Chicken Lasagna, this collection is packed with cheesy goodness, rich sauces and delicious Italian-inspired flavours.
Whether you're craving a comforting classic, a flavourful pesto pasta or an indulgent seafood dish, these recipes will help you bring restaurant-style pasta straight to your home kitchen.
Here's what we're making:
1. Creamy White Sauce Pasta – A rich, cheesy white sauce tossed with pasta, broccoli, yellow squash, cherry tomatoes and aromatic herbs.
